videoTitle: Bleeding on Birth Control? Here's What a Negative Test Really Means
videoDescription: Irregular bleeding while on hormonal birth control can feel terrifying—especially when you've heard stories about people who didn't know they were pregnant. But a negative pregnancy test plus consistent birth control use tells you something very specific. Find out what the research actually says at mindtivate.com.
script: You're bleeding irregularly on birth control, your pregnancy test says less than one, and you're still spiraling. Here's what that number actually means: it's detecting zero hCG, the pregnancy hormone, and standard tests turn positive around twenty-five...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up, high-contrast shot from a slightly high angle looking down at a woman sitting on a tiled bathroom floor, her head resting back against the wall in exhaustion. She is holding a digital pregnancy test in her hand that shows a negative result, while her other hand rests anxiously on her stomach, capturing a quiet moment of deep worry and confusion.
